messages:
ana: Heads-up — saw two eviction waves in us-west1-a over the last 3 hours. Spot GPU pool lost ~18% capacity each wave and CA started launching cold on-demand nodes, causing a bunch of 5-10s latency spikes for batch infer. We should throttle the rebalancer and bring a small warm pool + cross-az spillover online.

jeff: Agree. Could we do a short-term throttle + warm pool (label: warm=true) and taint warm nodes so only prewarmed workloads land there? Something like:
```yaml
nodePool:
  name: gpu-spot-warm
  minNodes: 2
  maxNodes: 6
  labels:
    warm: "true"
  taints:
    - key: warm
      value: true
      effect: NoSchedule
autoscalerFlags:
  - --balance-similar-node-groups=false
  - --expander=least-waste
  - --scale-down-unneeded-time=15m
```

maria: From metrics: eviction rate spiked from 0.3%->2.4% in the last 2h, median reclaim time ~90s. If we keep warm pool at ~10-15% of normal spot capacity we avoid most cold starts. 15% warm looks right for now.

patrick: We should also pre-pull model weights on the warm nodes (init container or DaemonSet) so pods boot faster. Add a label and nodeAffinity in pod spec: prefer: node.kubernetes.io/warm=true.

ana: @ana sorry typo — meant to tag you.

tim: Cost question — what's the incremental $$ if we keep 15% warm in us-west1-a + a 2-node on-demand spillover in us-west1-b? Rough calc: warm is idle GPUs so ~15% * spot baseline + 2 * on-demand VM-hour. We should log this in infra-cost channel before enabling.

jeff: For evacuation signals, let's wire up a lightweight webhook from the spot-controller to post to a k8s-event stream and set a CA throttle flag for 5m when eviction-rate > 1%. Pseudocode: `if eviction_rate > 0.01: set_rebalance_sleep(300)`

patrick: Also add a small PDB for inference pods (minAvailable: 80%) to avoid mass evictions during node reassign.

ana: (bot) deploying warm pool config to staging cluster now — will report back.

sre-bot: alert: spot-pool-us-west1-a eviction_rate=0.024 threshold=0.01 — auto-warmpool-triggered (2 nodes) — runbook: #gpu-evac-playbook

maria: After enabling warmpool + throttle we'll re-evaluate in 1h and check tail latencies and cost burn.

tim: If warmpool buys us steady latency, I'm fine with the short-term cost. Open a small PR and tag infra-costs, I'll approve the spend. :+1:
